```yaml
name: Docs Automation

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      run_claude:
        description: 'Whether to run Claude Code'
        required: true
        default: 'false'
        type: boolean
      create_pr:
        description: 'Whether to create PR in docs-new'
        required: true
        default: 'false'
        type: boolean
      max_turns:
        description: 'Max Claude turns (increase if hitting limit)'
        required: true
        default: '50'
        type: number

jobs:
  docs-automation:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v3
        with:
          node-version: '16'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Run Claude Code
        id: claudie
        uses: anthropics/claude-code-base-action@beta
        with:
          anthropic_api_key: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
          max_turns: ${{ github.event.inputs.max_turns }}
          prompt: |
            You are a documentation generator for Algolia's InstantSearch packages. Please generate documentation updates based on the latest release notes provided below.
            Release Notes:
            ```
            # Release Notes
            ## Version 4.0.0
            - Added support for new feature X
            - Fixed bug Y
            ```

      - name: Check if PR should be created
        id: check_pr
        run: echo "::set-output name=create_pr::$([[ ${{ github.event.inputs.create_pr }} == true ]] && echo "true" || echo "false")")

      - name: Create PR in docs-new
        if: steps.check_pr.outputs.create_pr == 'true'
        run: |
          git clone https://${{ github.actor }}:${{ secrets.DOCS_REPO_PAT }}@github.com/algolia/docs-new.git
          cd docs-new
          git checkout -b docs-automation-${{ github.sha }}
          cp ../instantsearch.js/.js.mdx .
          git add .js.mdx
          git commit -m "Update documentation for InstantSearch.js"
          git push origin docs-automation-${{ github.sha }}
          gh pr create --base main --head docs-automation-${{ github.sha }} --title "Automated documentation update" --body "This PR was automatically generated by the docs automation workflow."
```

Please note that this is a basic implementation and may need adjustments based on your specific requirements and environment. The `prompt` input in the `anthropics/claude-code-base-action` step is hardcoded for demonstration purposes; you will need to dynamically generate the prompt based on the actual release notes. Additionally, the `git clone`, `cd`, `git checkout`, `git add`, `git commit`, and `git push` commands are simplified for demonstration; you may need to handle errors and edge cases in a production environment.
